set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/spatial. Acceptance: represent Domain kind and morphism compatibility in constructors or phantom types; add route capability wrappers such as ExecutableAffinePath and VolumeToSurfacePath; model OperatorShape/OperatorRecipe/OperatorSignature so cache keys and provenance cannot drift; replace raw ROI row vectors with RowSelection/TargetRows; use image.SpatialPoint for finite 3D coordinates; structure SpatialError/SpatialIoError reasons. Verification: spatialJVM/test and spatialJS/test; cache roundtrip tests if signatures change.
set.title: Type spatial domains, routes, operators, and cache signatures
